limits: Proposed engineering fit-screen criteria, not manufacturer tolerances or release approval

parts.name: SG90 body and mounting ears
parts.hardware: ServoA thenB; two M1.6x8 screws, two M1.6 nuts, two small washers. Never M3 in original ears.
parts.method: Unplug power, detach horn, insert case through window until both original ears seat naturally. Fit both small screws without pulling ears into alignment. Finger seat only; repeat on BOTH servos.
criteria: Printed window23.30x12.80mm and hole pitch27.20mm, each within +/-0.15mm (proposed print-screen limits, NOT SG90 tolerances).
Case enters without spreading/scraping/forcing; both flat ear seating faces rest on ledge with no gap >0.15mm. Do not count molded relief as a seating face.
Both M1.6 screws enter simultaneously by hand; washers seat and nuts fully engage, with no ear bending/whitening/cracking.
This thin gauge does NOT test whole-case height, boss height, bracket captive M1.6 nut pockets, full installation or wire threading. Those stay NOT TESTED.

parts.name: Original star-horn positive pocket
parts.hardware: Original hornA thenB, DETACHED from servo; paper pointer/ruler/protractor.
parts.method: Keep cover OFF initially so friction cannot hide a failed profile. Seat detached horn in open pocket. Gently rock between first arm-wall contacts, without flexing arms. Use a paper pointer at20mm radius to measure total free play.
criteria: Horn seats flat by finger pressure, with no wedged hub, bent arm or raised-hub rocking. Nominal pocket2.20mm deep and2mm horn web are provisional.
Positive arm-wall stops in BOTH directions BEFORE clamping. Total free play <=4deg, equivalent to <=1.40mm total arc at20mm radius. Proposed screen criterion, not strength/backlash certification.
Check both real horns separately. A five-arm CAD profile is not evidence your original horn matches it.
Never force a gearbox or test with a printed spline; no exact spline teeth have been invented.

parts.name: Captive cover and retained horn
parts.hardware: Coupon02, hornA/B, four M3x10 screws/four standard M3 nuts. Original factory horn screws and correct driver for access comparison only.
parts.method: Finger-fit nuts in upward-open hex pockets. Put horn in02 and cover FLAT face against open cup, nut bosses OUTWARD. Fit four M3x10 from the opposite face. Seat rims gently and evenly; repeat for other horn.
criteria: All four nuts fully seat and resist rotation with finger fitting; screws start by hand for >=3 full turns. Do not heat-press nuts or enlarge pockets to call an initial PASS.
Rim gap <=0.10mm around perimeter, horn axial lift <=0.20mm, no bowing/crushing; criterion02 still applies independently.
Each screw projects >=1.0mm beyond seated nut; nominal2.1mm in this fixture. No head/nut interference.

Factory retaining screw HEAD and intended driver clear central8mm fixture access. NEVER substitute M3. Detached clearance is NOT proof of real factory screw thread/length or fully assembled access; record original screw availability separately.

parts.name: Camera21x16 center gauge
parts.hardware: UNPOWERED camera; four smooth nylon pins, or actual M2x12 only after real PCB holes freely accept the actual shank. Four M2 nuts are for later mount checks, not pulling PCB to gauge.
parts.method: Measure printed centers first. Hold gauge parallel to camera with VISIBLE clearance from all components/lens. Align four loose nylon pins without clamping. Its central8mm access hole is NOT lens clearance: never lay it over the lens or onto components.
criteria: Printed horizontal21.00 +/-0.15mm and vertical16.00 +/-0.15mm in a rectangle. Use equal smooth gauge pins: outside span minus mean pin diameter gives centers. User nominal21x16 is authoritative, NOT PCB outline.
All four axes align simultaneously without lateral forcing, bending or optical-module contact. Gauge holes2.4mm do not establish actual PCB hole diameter.
Actual camera screw shank must pass original hole freely. If M2 does not, mark M2 compatibility FAIL/UNVERIFIED even when pattern aligns. Never drill camera.
PCB outline, lens/IR field, rear electronics, standoffs and connector access are NOT passed by this gauge.

parts.name: Male pan journal ring
parts.method: Measure OD at0/45/90deg above first-layer ridge. Mate with LARGE opening of06; slide and turn two full revolutions in EACH direction using light fingers.
criteria: Male OD64.00 +/-0.15mm; OD ovality max-minus-min <=0.20mm.
Minimum female ID minus maximum male OD >=0.30mm; maximum ID minus minimum OD <=0.90mm. Nominal diametral gap0.60mm, radial0.30mm.
No press fit, springing, jamming or sticking in two360deg turns each way. Do not selectively sand before recording initial result.
2mm-thin rings test diameter/ovality/sliding, NOT full-height alignment, load, thrust wear or PETG creep.

parts.name: Female pan ring plus tilt-bore tab
parts.hardware: Male05, actual sleeve07; M3x10/nut may be reused after horn test.
parts.method: Measure large ID at0/45/90deg and pair with05. The NEW tab contains5.2mm bore through2.5mm thickness, matching nominal stationary tilt wall. Insert07 from UNDER the tab, flange below; neck projects above. See mating-detail CAD image.
criteria: Pan ID64.60 +/-0.15mm, ID ovality <=0.20mm; meet paired criteria05. Original entire ring material and ID are preserved.
Actual small-bore ID minus sleeve neck OD0.10..0.35mm diametral (target0.20mm). Smooth full-length insertion/turning, no forcing.
Neck projects >=0.20mm beyond tab face; nominal0.50mm before layer rounding.
Only this new coupon copy has the tab. It completes the missing tilt-bore test WITHOUT an eighth piece or assembly change.

parts.name: Actual reusable tilt sleeve
parts.hardware: Tab06; one M3x10 and standard M3 nut, optional washer. Production idler STILL needs separate M3x12/washer/locknut.
parts.method: Check actual M3 shank through sleeve. Insert neck through06 from below, flange against underside. With light finger seating, nut/bolt must clamp sleeve end/flange ONLY, never tab. Turn sleeve gently, release nut.
criteria: Intended neckOD5.00mm, inner bore3.20mm; actual M3 shank passes completely by hand without splitting/crushing.
Meet06 diametral gap0.10..0.35mm and end projection >=0.20mm; two full turns EACH direction without binding.
Tab remains free when nut bears on sleeve; stop if tightening removes clearance. No tightening-torque or load test.
Reuse sleeve only if undamaged. This does NOT pass final idler nut locking, complete stack or bracket alignment.
